name: Shielded Caster [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your allies cover you while you cast complicated spells.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, your ally receives a +4 competence bonus on concentration checks. If you are wielding a buckler or a light shield, this bonus increases by +1. If you are wielding a heavy shield or a tower shield, this bonus increases by +2. Finally, if an enemy threatening you and your ally has the Disruptive feat, or another ability that increases the DC of concentration checks, the amount of the increase is halved.
